conversation_tail.message: Redesign ContextForge UI — both web app and browser extension. Goal: Make it feel like a premium developer tool. Smooth, engaging, polished. Every interaction must feel intentional.

Completed full UI redesign across all 10 planned items: - Foundation: globals.css + tailwind.config.ts with shimmer, slide-up, fade-in, pulse-green keyframes - PlatformLogo SVG components for web and extension - Web: Sidebar, SessionCard, SessionList, MigrateView all redesigned - Extension: Sidebar and Popup redesigned - All TypeScript errors fixed, pushed to main
in the extension download script is not working fix it

Root cause: triggerDownload() used URL.createObjectURL() + anchor.click() which is blocked in Chrome MV3 extension pages. Fixes: 1. Added "downloads" permission to manifest.json 2. Updated triggerDownload() to use chrome.downloads.download() with data: URL (correct MV3 approach), with blob-URL fallback for web app context. TypeScript clean, pushed commit 35ad6b8.
Build succeeded. ✓ in 14.4s — no errors. dist/ folder ready. Load in Chrome: chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked → select dist/
